verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an API reference section covering Custom Integration Push APIs (integration monitoring) and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, plus documented inbound webhook endpoints that push external data into ingestion workflows. Together these are a real but narrow programmatic surface. The evidence is only page titles, the documented scope looks limited to pushing integration data and reading health or vendor data, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: evidence of broad API coverage to drive core workflows (controls, policies, risks, tasks, audits), documented auth and endpoint details, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
